purpose: Strengthen the JSP-000013 Exposition submission, not claim a solution, new quantization algorithm, or committee approval.
generator: NumPy Generator PCG64(seed), standard_normal X then standard_normal W divided by sqrt(128)
outlier_rule: Multiply only activation column zero. Reuse each seed's Gaussian X and W across multipliers. No fit on evaluated values.
quantizer: Symmetric four-bit maxabs, codes -7..7, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; activation row and weight output column grouped over contiguous input features; both operands quantized; float64 simulation.

transforms.randomized_hadamard: Q=diag(signs) H/sqrt(128), PCG64(seed+100000), signs choice from [-1.0,1.0]
transforms.haar_orthogonal: QR of 128x128 iid standard_normal from PCG64(seed+300000); multiply each Q column by sign of corresponding R diagonal, using +1 at zero
transforms.signed_permutation: PCG64(seed+400000), permutation(128) followed by choice signs from [-1.0,1.0]; Q=eye(128)[:,permutation] times signs per column

intervention: Xr=XQ and Wr=Q.T W; original uses identity. Same X,W,Q within each seed across groups and multipliers.

primary_endpoint.contrast: randomized_hadamard minus original mean relative squared Frobenius output error

primary_decision: Confirm the earlier directional result within the specified synthetic family only if the upper end of the paired 95% bootstrap interval is below zero. Report a nonconfirmation without tuning or rerunning new seeds.

bootstrap.secondary_intervals: descriptive, unadjusted; no familywise significance claims

negative_control.generator: PCG64(seed+200000), integer X then W in [-7,7], force X[:,0]=7 and W[0,:]=7
negative_control.requirement: original and signed-permutation errors zero to floating-point tolerance; do not omit rotation harm

exact_conjecture_checks.content: Prove the flat-entry minimax equivalence to Hadamard existence, determinant equality, and prime-field Paley construction. These are expository derivations of known mathematics, not priority claims.
exact_conjecture_checks.worked_example: Publish the complete order-12 matrix from q=11; do not imply power-of-two construction covers order 12.

retention: Retain every cell, input/transform hashes, source/protocol hashes, environment, timings and negative outcomes. Never overwrite an existing run directory.
scope_limits: Fresh pseudorandom draws from the same constructed family are not real-model validation.
No speed, memory-saving, award-probability, novelty-priority or conjecture-solution claim.
Do not alter original article or retained v1 results silently.
